description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of six characteristics associated with a reasoning benchmark for Large Language Models. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different characteristic: “Uncrushable” (light gray), “Unhackable” (light green), “Complexity Instance” (dark gray), “Scalable Oversight” (dark green), “Auto-verifiable” (purple), and “Coverage General” (gold). The slices are not labeled with percentages, but visually appear to be roughly equal in proportion, each taking up approximately 16-17% of the whole. A legend is present, associating each characteristic with its corresponding color. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding, and the slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order around the center of the chart.
